nodes.summary: Its complement is productive, hence not RE, but the complement of a computable set is RE.
nodes.title: A creative set is not computable

nodes.summary: A creative set is recursively enumerable, by definition.
nodes.title: A creative set is recursively enumerable

nodes.summary: A set $A$ of natural numbers is creative when it is recursively enumerable and its complement $\mathbb{N} \setminus A$ is productive.
nodes.title: Creative set

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $e$ and $n$, $n$ belongs to $W_e$, the $e$-th recursively enumerable set, when the partial recursive function $\varphi_e$ computed by the program with index $e$ in the standard numbering of partial recursive programs is defined at $n$; thus $W_e$ is the domain of $\varphi_e$.
nodes.title: Standard enumeration of the recursively enumerable sets

nodes.summary: It would be an infinite RE subset of itself.
nodes.title: An immune set is not recursively enumerable

nodes.summary: A set $A$ of natural numbers is immune when it is infinite and every recursively enumerable set $B \subseteq A$ is finite.
nodes.title: Immune set

nodes.summary: No productive set of natural numbers is recursively enumerable: if it were the $e$-th recursively enumerable set $W_e$, its productive function would produce a member of it outside $W_e$.
nodes.title: A productive set is not recursively enumerable

nodes.summary: A set $A$ of natural numbers is productive when there is a partial recursive function $f$ such that for every natural number $e$ with $W_e \subseteq A$, where $W_e$ is the $e$-th recursively enumerable set in the standard enumeration, $f(e)$ is defined, $f(e) \in A$ and $f(e) \notin W_e$.
nodes.title: Productive set

nodes.summary: The complement of a simple set is immune, by definition.
nodes.title: The complement of a simple set is immune

nodes.summary: Its complement would be an infinite RE set, contradicting immunity.
nodes.title: A simple set is not computable

nodes.summary: A simple set is recursively enumerable, by definition.
nodes.title: A simple set is recursively enumerable

nodes.summary: A set $P$ of natural numbers is simple when it is recursively enumerable and its complement $\{n \mid \neg P(n)\}$ is immune.
nodes.title: Simple set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
